message.subject: Strategic material opportunity for 3M
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I've been following 3M's recent Protection Wrap Film Color Series launch and wanted to reach out about a potential portfolio opportunity.

We work with manufacturers looking to address ultra-premium architectural and transit segments where durability requirements exceed typical vinyl performance. Our PVF films have helped partners reduce warranty exposure in high-vandalism applications where standard anti-graffiti solutions fall short.

Given your role in strategic sourcing, would it make sense to have a brief conversation about selective market segments where this might complement 3M's existing lineup? Happy to keep it confidential and exploratory.

Best,
[Your name]
